title: Stage the exact disabled-15 service change before Product history cleanup
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Отлично теперь пройдись по всем стратегиям, у которых Enabled = False и повтори ту же операцию - очисть историю и удали сами стратегии
Да вообще убери этот триггер, зачем он нужен?
Ты опять меня грузишь вещами, которые я не понимаю. Мне нужно просто удалить ненужные стратегии вместе с историей, чтобы почистить базу. Решай эту задачу.

scope.goal: Prepare and publish to master the exact service change required before deleting the fixed 15 unwanted Product strategies and their history.
inScope: Use the same fixed 15 UUID/code allowlist and identity SHA-256 9e5a735526b47548abdbabaedc11a46c4f8dc433c196f430cd68a387bf663578 approved by RC-20260901-remove-disabled-and-dependent-lower-enter-strategies.
Exclude the exact 15 identities from the runtime strategy catalog and remove every retained runtime catalog reference to them.
Preserve immutable baseline migration 0001 byte-for-byte by using its legacy catalog only when generating its existing LowerEnter seed SQL.

Add ordered transactional migration 0007 that removes only trg_historical_gross_net_parity_audit_immutable and leaves the audit table, function, indexes, insertions, reads, and accounting behavior unchanged.

Update only focused catalog/migration tests and documentation, run the focused tests and Release build, obtain independent semantic review, commit the completed source stage to master, and push it for user-controlled deployment.
outOfScope: Any Product or local database mutation, strategy/history deletion, cleanup marker, deployment, service stop/restart, order cancellation, or runtime-state change.
Changing immutable baseline 0001 generated SQL/checksum or any ordered migration other than adding 0007.
Changing any non-target strategy, trading behavior, accounting behavior, audit insertion/read path, trigger function, table, index, constraint, retention, archive, or compaction behavior.
Backup, dump, clone, reusable cleanup framework, physical compaction, VACUUM FULL, pg_repack, or REINDEX.
scope.periodOrFilter: The fixed exact 15 UUID/code identities approved for later Product cleanup; no database time window and no database mutation in this stage.
scope.firstVerification: Prove that PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CreateDefault retains the exact immutable baseline checksum before implementing the runtime catalog exclusion and migration 0007.

requirements.text: Prepare the service so it cannot dispatch the fixed 15 unwanted strategies after deployment.
requirements.sourceQuote: удалить ненужные стратегии вместе с историей
acceptanceCriteria: The runtime catalog contains none of the exact 15 UUID/code identities.
No retained runtime variant references any exact target through BaseSignalStrategyId, ConfirmationSignalStrategyId, or LowerEnterSourceStrategyId.
The exact immutable baseline migration 0001 semantic checksum remains 4dba8fe092057778ff146e61be43cabbb882358c679c8ee70ade832a872b00d2.

verification.command: Run RetiredProgressStrategyTests against the exact fixed 15 allowlist and retained-reference guards.
verification.expected: All exact targets and references are absent from the runtime catalog while the legacy baseline checksum remains unchanged.

requirements.text: Add ordered migration 0007 that removes only the exact immutable audit trigger.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration 0007 is transactional, checksum-bound, ordered after 0006, and contains only DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS for trg_historical_gross_net_parity_audit_immutable on public.historical_gross_net_parity_audit.
Immutable baseline 0001 and migrations 0002 through 0006 remain semantically unchanged.
The audit table, function, indexes, insertions, reads, and accounting behavior are unchanged.

verification.command: Run PostgresSchemaMigrationTests focused on the default ordered catalog, baseline checksum, and exact migration 0007 SQL/checksum.
verification.expected: The catalog has seven checksum-bound migrations, baseline 0001 is unchanged, and 0007 contains only the exact trigger drop.

requirements.text: Verify and publish only the bounded service-stage change to master for user deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: Focused tests pass with zero failures and the Release solution build completes with zero errors.
git diff --check and requirement validation pass in WorkingTree and Staged modes.
An independent reviewer compares the verbatim requests, approved contract, actual diff, tests, and evidence and returns PASS with no findings.
The implementation commit is pushed to origin/master without any database, deployment, service, order, or runtime mutation.

verification.command: dotnet build PolyCopyTrader.sln --configuration Release with disposable outputs under the active marked D:/CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: Release build completes with zero errors.

verification.command: Run git diff --check, requirement validation, and independent semantic review before the implementation commit.
verification.expected: Mechanical checks pass and the independent reviewer returns PASS with no findings.
